guns.text: Gillespie said he would support the Second Amendment in the Senate while also expressing concern about gun violence.
guns.quote: As a United States Senator I will support the Second Amendment. That said, I am concerned with gun violence in our Great County.

health.text: Gillespie proposes national health coverage that allows people to opt out.
health.quote: I propose national health coverage, with the ability to opt-out.

tax.text: Moody supported tax exemptions for Social Security income, tips, and overtime and said she would continue pursuing tax cuts.
tax.quote: That is why I supported no tax on Social Security, no tax on tips, and no tax on overtime.

trade.text: Moody voted against a Senate resolution that would have terminated the national emergency used to impose global tariffs.
trade.quote: A joint resolution terminating the national emergency declared to impose global tariffs.

schools.text: Moody supported the Educational Choice for Children Act and promoted expanding educational choice nationwide.
schools.quote: As a proud supporter of The Educational Choice for Children Act, which is now law, we are empowering parents by supporting educational freedom across the country.

safety.text: Moody advanced a package of pro-law-enforcement bills and called for more training, tools, staffing, and resources for officers.
safety.quote: I will continue fighting for comprehensive legislation that provides training and tools, supports officers’ mental health, delivers resources needed for them to do their job and keeps our communities safe.

immigration.text: Moody introduced legislation requiring removal proceedings to conclude within 15 days for immigrants who have been ordered removed.
immigration.quote: This legislation is critical to build upon those early successes and allow for the prompt removal of aliens who have already been ordered removed.

guns.text: Moody cosponsored legislation recognizing concealed-carry privileges across state lines and described existing barriers as arbitrary.
guns.quote: This commonsense legislation will cut down arbitrary barriers and uphold Americans’ rights to keep and bear arms.

abortion.text: Moody introduced legislation imposing federal penalties for transporting a minor across state lines to evade parental-consent or notification requirements for an abortion.
abortion.quote: This legislation would make it a federal offense to knowingly transport a minor across state lines without complying with parental consent and notification laws.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Moody cosponsored legislation defining sex under Title IX as biological sex and barring athletes assigned male at birth from women’s school sports.
gender.quote: Male athletes have no business competing in women’s sports, and it’s mindboggling that in 2026 we must pass legislation to protect meaningful opportunity for girls to compete.

energy.text: Moody supported rolling back federal emissions and refrigerant rules that she said increased costs and harmed businesses and jobs.
energy.quote: For years—as both Florida’s Attorney General and now as U.S. Senator—I have fought back against these harmful, ultra-progressive policies that drive up costs, hurt businesses, and undermine economic growth.

voting.text: Moody urged passage of the SAVE America Act to require identification for voting.
voting.quote: And I rise to say that we have to pass, without delay, the Save America Act. This would require ID to vote.

wages.text: She supports the PRO Act, stronger unions, and an inflation-indexed federal living wage.
wages.quote: Raising the federal minimum wage to a real living wage, indexed to inflation, for every worker, including immigrant and incarcerated workers.

schools.text: She supports fully funding public K-12 schools and increasing teacher pay.
schools.quote: Fully funding public K-12 schools and increased teacher wages

safety.text: She supports demilitarizing policing and shifting investment toward community safety, violence prevention, and crisis response.
safety.quote: Demilitarizing policing and investing in community-based public safety, violence prevention and crisis response

guns.text: She offered an amendment requiring firearm training before purchasing a firearm or carrying one in public.
guns.quote: Must complete firearm training to purchase a firearm or carry a firearm in public.

gender.text: She opposes excluding transgender girls and women from girls’ and women’s sports and pledges to defend transgender people’s equal participation.
gender.quote: To trans kids, their parents, and to trans folks everywhere: I see you, I support you, and I will never stop fighting for your right to exist freely, openly and equally.

health.text: She supports Medicare for All without premiums, deductibles, copays, or surprise bills.
health.quote: Medicare for All that covers every person in America — free at the point of service, with no premiums, no deductibles, no copays, and no surprise bills.

sources: scribd.com · onyourballot.vote411.org · moody.senate.gov · senate.gov · angienixon.com · flsenate.gov
